notes.notes:
[p][b]Hello friends! [/b][/p][p][/p][p]We have finished work on the upcoming version v0.103. The update will be released on another platform tomorrow (due to certain distribution requirements). On Steam, the game will be available in about three weeks. In the meantime, we are already moving forward with the next version v0.104. Below you will find answers to some of your questions about the game:
[/p][p align="justify"][b]I purchased the game on steam.  If I download an update from another shop will it update the steam version?[/b][/p][p align="justify"]The Steam version of the game is a separate build and differs in some minor aspects.[/p][p][/p][p align="justify"][b]Will you add achievements in the future?[/b][/p][p align="justify"]Currently, the game has an internal achievement system, but it is not connected to Steam achievements. We plan to add Steam achievement synchronization once the full game chapter is complete.[/p][p][/p][p align="justify"][b]It would be nice to have +18 voice acting.[/b][/p][p]Some scenes are already voiced, if you mean moans, sighs (the voices of female characters), and certain interaction sounds. But I agree there could definitely be more of them. However, this is a painstaking process that takes time. At the moment, this work is handled by our lead writer, which means he doesn’t always have the time to search for, edit, and implement “deep” sound effects and voice samples.
[/p][p align="justify"][b]All activities with Alexandra disappeared after I improved my relationship with her.[/b][/p][p]Yes, that’s correct. The storyline with Alexandra, right after raising your relationship with her, leads down a path that temporarily limits her FreeRoam interactions. Without spoilers, I can’t explain the exact reason, but this was done intentionally: at the moment we are focusing on developing the storylines of Kate and Elena, while Alexandra remains in a sort of “frozen” state. The stories of all three girls are closely intertwined, so we cannot move Alexandra’s plot further just yet without breaking the overall narrative consistency.

notes.title: AMNESIA. PROGRESS REPORT v0.102. WEEK #4-5
notes.notes:
[p][b]Hello friends! [/b][/p][p]We’re already on the final stretch. All planned scenes are done and implemented in the code. We're currently working on final polishing, voiceovers, and text editing. Everything will be ready soon (+we will need time to translate to all languages). I can’t give an exact date, but it’s coming very soon. For the scene with Alexandra, I managed to create 50 new animations.[/p][p]Let me answer some of your questions from the comments. Regarding DOM and LOVE routes for characters, there will only be two paths—simply because we don't have time for more. The LOVE route will differ for each girl. For example, Alexandra’s LOVE route means she will take the initiative much more often (it’s still not outright submissive, but knowing her character... anything can happen... at least occasionally!). Kate’s and Elena’s behaviors will also differ according to their own personalities.[/p][p]We're building the game in such a way that old saves (starting from the remastered version 0.100) should work in all future versions. Only saves made before the remaster won't work. We also have a function that signals which saves have conflicts and which are suitable. So if your saves aren't working for some reason, please report this in Discord (in the appropriate channel), as it's a bug and we didn't intend for saves to behave like this.[/p][p]Regarding the time required to remake old scenes (re-rendering animations in the MC’s room with Alexandra) and other minor things—these will be secondary tasks, handled whenever there’s rendering downtime from new scenes. We won’t prioritize this, but we won't forget about it either. I assume you'd prefer to see new animations rather than re-rendered old ones.[/p][p]As for adding new languages to the game (such as Thai or Turkish), we won’t even discuss adding new languages until we fully manage the current translation list and get it running smoothly. Translating is tedious, complex work requiring considerable time, meticulousness, and creativity. Right now, I’m thinking it would be best to add new languages only at the very end, once everything else is finalized. If you only knew how much has to be redone (in terms of translations) just because of changing a single word in the code... Sometimes I just feel like changing nothing at all! Simply to avoid creating extra translation work afterward! I hope you understand.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your support, Super Alex.[/p][p][/p][p]----------------------------------------[/p][p][/p][p][b][i][u]What was done during weeks 4-5:[/u][/i][/b]

Happy New Year everybody!

This year has been very eventful.

First of all, my financial situation has changed, thanks to the Steam release I could afford to bring in new people. I started working on the game alone, but now I have 7 people in my team. Working in a team is a new experience for me and I have never had to deal with something like that, I was doubtful, I was afraid, but now I can definitely say that working in a team is more interesting and productive! This is a new stage in my development and the game. All thanks to you, my Patreon and Steam supporters. I'm immensely grateful to YOU!

But before I had time to fully enjoy these new opportunities, barriers, artificial obstacles, and sanctions began to appear... All of this led in the end to me moving to another country. But I'll leave all that in the past year!

This new year should bring even more interesting content, new ideas and further development of the game!

At the moment all static renders and animations (282 pictures + 15 animations) for the upcoming update are finished. In the next couple of days, as soon as the New Year festivities slow down, I'll start post-processing and assembling the scenes in Ren'Py.

THANK YOU for staying with us during this challenging year. Your support is very important to us.

notes.title: AMNESIA. RELEASE v0.88
notes.notes:
Hi Friends!

[u]AMNESIA v0.88c is now available on STEAM![/u]

About two weeks ago I finished another update. All the found errors and problems have been fixed and now I'm sure that the game is stable enough for a Steam release.

I haven't posted any news for a long time, so let me briefly tell you about the current situation.
After some well-known events, the usual course of work had to be quickly changed, trying new software, looking for alternative ways to transfer and receive money. All these difficulties are behind us now. I want to thank everyone who wrote to me personally and asked how I was doing! Nothing to worry about, I'm fine. Work on the project is moving but slowly, even if I would like it otherwise, this is just how it is for now. Still, the work is progressing. 

The writer writes dialogues for future scenes, he has already created a significant groundwork for artists to work with, and soon we will work with him on writing the remaining scenes until the end of the storylines with Alexandra, Kate and Elena. One of my new artists has already made several scenes and I like the quality of his work more and more each time, I still correct his work a little, but soon I expect that he will do everything just right the first time. I had to give up the other two artists, but I have already found a replacement, so I hope it will go better with the new guys. Now something slightly different. I made three very long animations recently, which I have not done yet, more than 20 seconds each. Now I can do even longer animations since I've upgraded my graphics card, which is another good news.

Just recently I received a 3080ti graphics card from China, so I upgraded my old 1080ti and the rendering performance doubled. I will install another 3080ti in the near future (I already have it at home), which will increase the speed by another 50%, and as a result, I won't have to worry about the rendering performance in the nearest future. Since I'm still planning on getting my three artists up to 1,500 images a month (500 images each), I'll be ready to handle that many images.
Also during this time the game was fully translated into Russian, and English got improved and edited in many places, especially the beginning.

At the moment, my artists are already working on the next update and 2 scenes out of 9 are already finished. I will try to get in touch more often and keep you up to date with all the news. Thank you all for your support and for giving me time to get back on track, I really want to consistently release big quality updates, but my team and I are still not at that level.
Thank you SUPER ALEX

notes.notes:
[b]Hello Friends![/b]

I want to share with you some news that concern me personally and also the project.

In case somebody didn't know, I'm from Russia. I'm not ashamed of that, because I'm not responsible for the decisions of our government. Personally, I'm against any wars and conflicts , and I don't support them. I wish there were no conflicts at all. But what happens, happens, and I can't influence it in any way.

Part of the sanctions that were introduced affected me as well. Namely, now I'm limited in receiving money, some banks are also completely blocked from international transfers, and I think that this list will continue to grow. I had difficulty paying my team because some of them are abroad, but money transfers to other countries are now also limited. This all created a strong need to open reserve accounts, preferably outside the country, in order to deal with all these problems and possibly future ones.

However, I continue to teach new artists and the writer keeps writing new texts. I do not despair, because the situation could be even worse.

I will keep you informed and hope that everything will be resolved in the most favourable way for everyone.

With gratitude, SUPER ALEX

[b]Hello Friends![/b]

I haven't checked Steam for a long time and just yesterday I read all your comments and good wishes! I'm very grateful to you for your support, to each and every one of you!

What's new?! The process of building a stable workflow is underway, but not everything is going as planned (and that is normal). In particular, not all of the translators who expressed a desire to help got in touch with us. However, this doesn't upset me, we just need to keep searching. That is why I will pin the message about the search for translators in the discussion forum.

As for the next update, I would have loved to do it at the beginning of March, but here I will draw an analogy with a car (that car is my project). I drove my car to a car service, where they will upgrade it so that it moves faster in the future. Upgrading (building a team and setting up a proper workflow) takes time, and during this time you can't take your car from the car service every day to use it for regular business (make content for the next update). Upgrading will take time, but investing in this process now will pay off with interest in the future. 

I hope you understand.
With gratitude, SUPER ALEX

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41559903/a29499b934351f4d4d0b1e7489d80b50f8ea4b27.jpg[/img]
[b]Hello Friends![/b]

Last week I didn't manage to create much content for the next update, but I did some organizational work. At the moment, several tasks are being worked on simultaneously:

[b]Translations[/b]: English - being edited, German - ready, French and Spanish - actively talking with translators, Russian - my plan is that the new writer will be able to edit the old text and translate the rest of it (more about this below), Chinese - there were some problems with the cost of translation, we are now looking for the best option. Also, Chinese will require different fonts and some other settings  (this is a task for coder)

[b]Coder[/b]: We put the phone on hold due to the issues with fonts used in the game. Therefore, we've decided to focus on the main task first. He is currently in the process of adapting existing fonts in the game to new languages (adding missing characters, doing adjustments) to ensure that all planned languages will be displayed correctly in the game.

[b]Writer[/b]: I've decided to look for a new Russian-speaking writer in order to improve the workflow and communication in the team. I can say that somebody like that was found, and he is now studying the main story and getting better understanding of all the main characters. I also count on him to slightly edit the already written Russian text and to translate the missing text from the last update.

[b]Artists[/b]: So far, there are three people that I'm training in order to improve their work, so that they could on the same level as me. This will take a lot of time, but it's the only way to increase the amount of content in future updates. I'm not sure if this is the final number of people or if I will look for a fourth person (4 artists - that was my original plan). Time will tell.

In general, I'm slowly moving forward with the planned expansion of the team. However, it is really difficult to switch from the role of work organizer to the role of artist. I will continue to develop these new skills in myself.

With gratitude, SUPER ALEX

All this has become possible thanks to you! Thank you for believing in me and in the project. I have a great desire to meet your expectations. For me, this is a new page in game development.
